hook: Your terminal sessions now fit in your pocket.
hookText: Rex lands in the App Store

beats.say: Mitchell Hashimoto's new app Rex is live in the App Store. It puts terminal sessions from your Mac, Linux and Windows machines on your iPhone and iPad.
Sessions keep running on your computers, so you can check on coding agents, answer a prompt or approve a command from anywhere, then hand the pane back to your Mac.
It is free and needs a Rex Server running on another device, which Hashimoto hints is close to a full public release.
